description: This file defines the interface for IMediaKeySession and its factory within the Rialto media server component. It includes class declarations, method signatures for managing media key sessions, and references to external classes like IMediaKeysClient and IOcdmSystem.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaKeySession instances, providing a static method to create the factory and a method to create media key sessions.

classes.name: IMediaKeySession
classes.description: Interface defining the operations for a media key session, including license request generation, session loading, updating, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeySessionFactory instance.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request with specified init data type and data.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing media key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with license response data.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted media data, with an overload marked for deprecation.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if the session contains a specific key.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session, specific to Netflix.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system is PlayReady.
